topics.title: Register a farm

Enter its reported location, keeping uncertainty explicit.

topics.title: Record a field observation

topics.after_save: Refresh and inspect the saved record. Keep earlier entries when making a correction.

fields.label: Field
fields.meaning: Choose the plot you actually inspected.
fields.example: DEMO: the registered south plot.

fields.label: Category
fields.meaning: Select General, Crop health, Water, Pest observation or Operations to describe the report, not a confirmed cause.

fields.label: Source
fields.meaning: State who/what reported the observation. A source label is not independent verification.

fields.meaning: Choose Unknown unless stable or worsening was actually established.

fields.label: Volumetric soil moisture
fields.meaning: Enter a measured volumetric percentage only when supported by the selected method. Blank is unmeasured; zero is a measured zero.
fields.example: DEMO: 18.5 only if a suitable instrument measured 18.5%; otherwise leave blank.

fields.label: Measurement method
fields.meaning: Match the moisture entry to its method. Do not substitute visual dryness for a volumetric reading.
fields.example: DEMO: Volumetric sensor only for an actual compatible reading.

fields.label: What did you observe?
fields.meaning: Describe location, sample and visible facts. State unknown causes as unknown.
fields.example: DEMO: I checked 6 plants in a marked sample; 2 had small cobs. Cob maturity and cause remain unknown.

fields.label: Actual local time
fields.meaning: Enter when the activity or observation actually occurred, not a convenient date. Use the field label to see whether blank means now or is required. NEXUS converts local date-time entries to UTC where this form requires a timestamp.
fields.example: DEMO format: 15 January, 09:30 in your local clock. Do not copy a fictional time into an actual report.

glossary.Observation: A saved report of what someone observed, with source and time; it is not a diagnosis.
glossary.Task: A workspace review/work item created from an observation. Approval and recorded completion are separate stages.
glossary.Human decision: A person-selected plan based on a saved evidence bundle. It does not execute work.
glossary.Work order: A separate human-planned work item with owner, checklist and status history.
glossary.Reported outcome: A user-entered later result. It does not establish causation or treatment effectiveness.
glossary.Unknown: Information has not been established. It is not a numeric zero.
glossary.Zero: A numeric value of none/zero that was actually established; do not use it for missing information.
glossary.Source label: A user-reported description of where data came from. It does not authenticate the source.
glossary.Test material: Synthetic or scripted demonstration content kept separate from actual farm evidence.
glossary.Growth stage: The stage of the relevant plants at the time described. Do not infer it solely from a season name.
glossary.Season link: A user-recorded association between an observation and a crop season, supported by a stated basis.
glossary.Volumetric moisture: Water volume as a percentage of soil volume, requiring an appropriate measurement method; not a visual dryness estimate.
glossary.Sample: The specific plants/cobs/readings inspected. Counts are not automatically representative of a whole field.
glossary.Cob denominator: The number of cobs counted. It differs from the number of plants inspected.
glossary.UTC: The common time reference used for saved timestamps. A local time display can represent the same instant.
glossary.Lagos calendar date: A date interpreted in Africa/Lagos for planning/review-date comparisons.
glossary.Review bundle: A frozen copy of saved evidence at capture time; later record edits do not update it.
glossary.Decision cycle: A frozen capture of a decision, its supporting evidence and available linked work/reviews at capture.
glossary.Content hash / SHA-256: A consistency check of content, not proof of who wrote it or whether it is agriculturally accurate.
glossary.Manifest: A file listing backup/export properties and hashes for consistency checks.
glossary.CSV: A table stored as text with named columns. Follow the template; quote text containing commas.
glossary.Atomic import: All accepted rows save in one transaction, or no partial set is committed if an error occurs.
glossary.Preview: A review stage before commit. A preview is not a saved farm measurement.
glossary.Stale form: The underlying record changed since the form was loaded. Refresh and review before saving again.
glossary.Superseded: An earlier record has a later correction. It remains in history.
glossary.Withdrawn link: An association that was explicitly withdrawn while preserving the earlier source reference.
glossary.Pinned note: A note placed at the top of a list; pinning does not verify its contents.
glossary.Estimated cost: A planning estimate, separate from actual cash paid.
glossary.Kobo / NGN: 100 kobo equals 1 naira. Cash reports store amounts as integer kobo.
glossary.Net recorded cash: Selected recorded sale amounts minus selected recorded expenses; it is not profit.
glossary.Restore to copy: Create a new verified database file rather than overwrite the running one.
glossary.Confidence score: No calibrated confidence is supplied by these record checks or the existing ASR workflow.
glossary.Recorded stock balance: Sum of latest saved receipts, issues and signed adjustments; not a verified physical count.
glossary.Available stock: Recorded balance minus active reservations in the same supply unit.
glossary.Budget commitment: A planned or agreed cost line, separate from an actual expense or payment.
glossary.Person-hours: Total hours of work across people; not clock duration if several people worked together.
glossary.Resource revision: A new version of the same record. Earlier entries remain; field, type and actual/test source stay fixed.
glossary.Lot allocation: An association of part or all of a saved stock movement with a batch. It never creates a second movement.
glossary.Frozen expense match: A saved copy of one whole existing expense associated with a budget line. It does not record payment or all actual spending.
glossary.Changed since link: The current linked record differs from the saved copy. The saved copy remains intact for review.
glossary.Unallocated movement: The part of a recorded stock movement not yet associated with a lot. It is not evidence of missing stock.
glossary.Market ledger: A separate set of user-reported produce/order quantities and money. It does not post core-stock or Finance transactions.
glossary.Confirmed order reservation: Outstanding quantity reserved by active lines of a confirmed order, minus net deliveries after returns.
glossary.Net receipts: Reported receipts minus reported refunds for an order; not independently verified payment.
glossary.Restocked return: A returned quantity explicitly reported as returned to available market-lot stock. Quarantined/discarded returns are excluded.
glossary.Order statement: A dated copy of current saved order records, not an authenticated or tax invoice.
glossary.Local offer draft: A manually downloadable offer description. NEXUS does not publish or send it.

errors.title: The record changed after the form loaded
errors.meaning: The form is protecting newer work from being overwritten. Keep any unsaved notes separately, refresh the relevant records, compare the newest content, then make your intended change again.

errors.title: Stored consistency check failed
errors.meaning: Do not treat this as verified evidence. Read the check details and preserve the database/backup. A hash failure is a record consistency issue, not an agricultural finding.

errors.title: Test material is blocked from farm evidence
errors.meaning: Keep it labelled as test material. Use a genuinely actual farmer recording/reading for farm evidence; do not relabel a test just to make a button work.

errors.title: The CSV preview is too old
errors.meaning: Upload again to generate a new preview, review the rows/source and confirm that new preview. The old preview has not created additional readings.

errors.title: The record association needs checking
errors.meaning: Refresh the lists and choose the existing field/observation this report actually concerns. Register a missing field first; never guess an ID.

errors.title: The time does not meet this form’s rules
errors.meaning: Use the actual event time, or a planned date where asked. Timestamp imports need an explicit timezone. Read the field label before using blank to mean now.

errors.title: A required field is missing or invalid
errors.meaning: Open field Help. Enter actual information, or explicit Unknown only where text/choices allow it. Do not put Unknown into a numeric box; follow that form’s blank-value rules.

errors.title: Check the sample counts and units
errors.meaning: Affected plants cannot exceed checked plants. Plant and cob counts are separate. If grouping cobs, all group counts including zero must sum to cobs checked.

errors.title: Check the route and running server
errors.meaning: Use the operations launcher from the NEXUS project folder, leave its terminal running and open a supported local route. A missing route and a refused connection are different problems.

privacy: Help uses the shipped guide catalogue. It does not upload or store your typed form values, farm records or search history. Optional help preferences store only guide IDs in this browser and are shared by people using that browser profile.
limits: Help explains the interface. It does not verify facts, supply a diagnosis, approve work or run speech/model inference.
